claims.text: Cognition reports Devin's PR merge rate rose to 67% from 34% the prior year.
Cognition reports Devin completes vulnerability fixes in about 1.5 minutes versus about 30 minutes for humans.
Cognition reports Devin completes ETL migrations in 3-4 hours versus 30-40 hours for humans.
Cognition says Devin performs worse when given more instructions after it starts a task and does best with clear requirements.
Cognition states human review is still necessary because code quality is not straightforwardly verifiable.
Since March 2026, Devin can split a task across managed Devins, each running in its own isolated VM.
Since March 2026, a managing Devin can read the trajectories of the Devins it manages.
